cards.name: PSAdapter_plugin_Chrm
cards.summary: Hidden id with no visible menu item in Illustrator 30.2.1: the harvest found it only in the Defaults.kys menu list, not on the menu bar and not in the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog. Its code matches Chrome (Effect/Sketch/Chrome, id Live PSAdapter_plugin_Chrm), which renders the art as polished liquid chrome: its tones become swirling grey reflective highlights and shadows and the colour is dropped; this bare id is most likely the leftover of the old Filter-menu version of that filter, and what executing it does in 30.2.1 was not tested.
cards.how: Not reachable from the menus. The working route is Effect > Sketch > Chrome: select the object, set Detail, Smoothness in the dialog, OK; it stays editable in the Appearance panel.
cards.script_api: Harvested id: app.executeMenuCommand("PSAdapter_plugin_Chrm"), never executed or paired with a menu item, so its effect is unknown (it may do nothing). Same job, working: select the art and app.executeMenuCommand("Live PSAdapter_plugin_Chrm"), which opens the 'Chrome (100%)' Effect Gallery dialog with its last-used values and needs an OK. item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="PSAdapter_plugin_Chrm">...</LiveEffect>') stores Chrome without a dialog, but Detail and Smoothness sit in a binary descriptor that Dict data cannot carry, so a scripted apply runs with the plug-in's fallback settings, not chosen ones.
use_for: recognising this id in an old action, script or .kys shortcut set and swapping in Effect/Sketch/Chrome
a liquid-metal texture for a poster title or badge (through Effect/Sketch/Chrome, not this id)
avoid: new artwork and scripts: use Effect/Sketch/Chrome (Live PSAdapter_plugin_Chrm), a live effect that stays re-editable
colour artwork: Chrome returns greys only

review.changes: scriptable partial -> no: the harvested executeMenuCommand id was never run and may do nothing (same rule as the reviewed kys-only ids in ai_menu_21 and the PSAdapter ids in ai_menu_24); the working Live route stays in script_api; script_api: applyEffect was sold as the working, dialog-free route, but the harvest says the Photoshop parameters (Detail and Smoothness) cannot be sent in Dict data (fallback settings); the dialog route now leads and the applyEffect limit is stated

Its code matches Fresco (Effect/Artistic/Fresco, id Live PSAdapter_plugin_Frsc), which repaints the art with coarse, short, rounded dabs and darkened, contrasty shadows; this bare id is most likely the leftover of the old Filter-menu version of that filter, and what executing it does in 30.2.1 was not tested.
cards.how: Not reachable from the menus. The working route is Effect > Artistic > Fresco: select the object, set Brush Size, Brush Detail, Texture in the dialog, OK; it stays editable in the Appearance panel.
cards.script_api: Harvested id: app.executeMenuCommand("PSAdapter_plugin_Frsc"), never executed or paired with a menu item, so its effect is unknown (it may do nothing). Same job, working: select the art and app.executeMenuCommand("Live PSAdapter_plugin_Frsc"), which opens the 'Fresco (100%)' Effect Gallery dialog with its last-used values and needs an OK. item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="PSAdapter_plugin_Frsc">...</LiveEffect>') stores Fresco without a dialog, but Brush Size, Brush Detail and Texture sit in a binary descriptor that Dict data cannot carry, so a scripted apply runs with the plug-in's fallback settings, not chosen ones; in the harvest render check that route drew the probe solid black, so it is not a working route.
use_for: recognising this id in an old action, script or .kys shortcut set and swapping in Effect/Artistic/Fresco
a rough painted mural or fresco look (through Effect/Artistic/Fresco, not this id)
avoid: new artwork and scripts: use Effect/Artistic/Fresco (Live PSAdapter_plugin_Frsc), a live effect that stays re-editable
light, airy artwork: Fresco darkens it heavily

review.changes: scriptable partial -> no: the harvested executeMenuCommand id was never run and may do nothing (same rule as the reviewed kys-only ids in ai_menu_21 and the PSAdapter ids in ai_menu_24); the working Live route stays in script_api; script_api: applyEffect was sold as the working, dialog-free route, but the harvest says the Photoshop parameters (Brush Size, Brush Detail and Texture) cannot be sent in Dict data (solid-black render); the dialog route now leads and the applyEffect limit is stated

cards.name: PSAdapter_plugin_GblR
cards.summary: Hidden id with no visible menu item in Illustrator 30.2.1: the harvest found it only in the Defaults.kys menu list, not on the menu bar and not in the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog. Its code sits beside the legacy Blur codes (Radial Blur RdlB, Smart Blur SmrB) in that list and the harvest's name scan listed 'Adobe PSL Gaussian Blur' among its name candidates, so it is most likely the old Photoshop-adapter Gaussian Blur filter; that is an inference, and what executing this bare id does in 30.2.1 was not tested.
cards.how: Not reachable from the menus. The current blur is Effect > Blur > Gaussian Blur (id Live Adobe PSL Gaussian Blur, a different plug-in): select the object, set the radius in the dialog, OK; it stays editable in the Appearance panel.
cards.script_api: Harvested id: app.executeMenuCommand("PSAdapter_plugin_GblR"), never executed or paired with a menu item, so its effect is unknown (it may do nothing). Same job, working: item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="Adobe PSL Gaussian Blur"><Dict data="..."/></LiveEffect>') applies the current Gaussian Blur without a dialog (Dict keys PrevDocScale, NeedHighResExecution, PrevDres and blur, the radius; values as on the Gaussian Blur effect card); app.executeMenuCommand("Live Adobe PSL Gaussian Blur") opens its dialog.
use_for: recognising this id in an old action, script or .kys shortcut set and swapping in Effect/Blur/Gaussian Blur
soft drop shadows, glows and defocused backgrounds (through Effect/Blur/Gaussian Blur, not this id)
avoid: new artwork and scripts: use Effect/Blur/Gaussian Blur (Live Adobe PSL Gaussian Blur), the live, re-editable blur
treating this id as a confirmed Gaussian Blur: the name is inferred, not harvested

cards.name: PSAdapter_plugin_GEfc
cards.summary: Hidden id with no visible menu item in Illustrator 30.2.1: the harvest found it only in the Defaults.kys menu list, not on the menu bar and not in the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog. Its code matches Effect Gallery (Effect/Effect Gallery, id Live PSAdapter_plugin_GEfc), which opens the Effect Gallery, the Photoshop Filter Gallery dialog that previews every Artistic, Brush Strokes, Distort, Sketch, Stylize and Texture gallery filter in one window; the harvest's menu-route probe opened it on the last-used gallery filter (Stamp) and stored LiveEffect PSAdapter_plugin_Stmp; this bare id is most likely the leftover of the old Filter-menu Filter Gallery command, and what executing it does in 30.2.1 was not tested.
cards.how: Not reachable from the menus. The working route is Effect > Effect Gallery: select the object, pick a filter from the folders, set its sliders in the preview window, OK; the chosen filter is stored as that filter's own live effect.
cards.script_api: Harvested id: app.executeMenuCommand("PSAdapter_plugin_GEfc"), never executed or paired with a menu item, so its effect is unknown (it may do nothing). Same job, working: app.executeMenuCommand("Live PSAdapter_plugin_GEfc") opens the modal Effect Gallery on the selection, on the last-used gallery filter, and needs an OK; for a chosen filter apply its own live effect (item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="PSAdapter_plugin_<code>">...</LiveEffect>')), whose sliders cannot be passed in Dict data.
use_for: recognising this id in an old action, script or .kys shortcut set and swapping in Effect/Effect Gallery
comparing painterly, sketch and texture looks on one object before committing (through Effect/Effect Gallery, not this id)
avoid: new artwork and scripts: use Effect/Effect Gallery (Live PSAdapter_plugin_GEfc), which stores the chosen filter as its own live effect that stays re-editable
unattended scripts: the gallery is a modal dialog

Its code matches NTSC Colors (Effect/Video/NTSC Colors, id Live PSAdapter_plugin_NTSC), which restricts the colours to the range NTSC television can reproduce, pulling over-saturated colours down; it has no settings; this bare id is most likely the leftover of the old Filter-menu version of that filter, and what executing it does in 30.2.1 was not tested.
cards.how: Not reachable from the menus. The working route is Effect > Video > NTSC Colors: select the object, choose it (there are no settings); it stays editable in the Appearance panel.
cards.script_api: Harvested id: app.executeMenuCommand("PSAdapter_plugin_NTSC"), never executed or paired with a menu item, so its effect is unknown (it may do nothing). Same job, working: item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="PSAdapter_plugin_NTSC">...</LiveEffect>') applies NTSC Colors (its only key is go; it has no settings), or select the art and app.executeMenuCommand("Live PSAdapter_plugin_NTSC"), which applies it at once: it opens no dialog.
use_for: recognising this id in an old action, script or .kys shortcut set and swapping in Effect/Video/NTSC Colors
graphics headed for NTSC broadcast video (through Effect/Video/NTSC Colors, not this id)
avoid: new artwork and scripts: use Effect/Video/NTSC Colors (Live PSAdapter_plugin_NTSC), a live effect that stays re-editable
print and web work: it only dulls saturated colour

review.changes: scriptable partial -> no: the harvested executeMenuCommand id was never run and may do nothing (same rule as the reviewed kys-only ids in ai_menu_21 and the PSAdapter ids in ai_menu_24); the working Live route stays in script_api; script_api: the Live menu route was said to open a dialog; the harvest records no dialog (dialog_titles empty, menu label 'NTSC Colors' without an ellipsis), it applies at once

cards.name: PSAdapter_plugin_OcnR
cards.summary: Hidden id with no visible menu item in Illustrator 30.2.1: the harvest found it only in the Defaults.kys menu list, not on the menu bar and not in the Keyboard Shortcuts dialog. Its code matches Ocean Ripple (Effect/Distort/Ocean Ripple, id Live PSAdapter_plugin_OcnR), which adds randomly spaced, small ripples, as if the art lay under a moving water surface; this bare id is most likely the leftover of the old Filter-menu version of that filter, and what executing it does in 30.2.1 was not tested.
cards.how: Not reachable from the menus. The working route is Effect > Distort > Ocean Ripple: select the object, set Ripple Size, Ripple Magnitude in the dialog, OK; it stays editable in the Appearance panel.
cards.script_api: Harvested id: app.executeMenuCommand("PSAdapter_plugin_OcnR"), never executed or paired with a menu item, so its effect is unknown (it may do nothing). Same job, working: select the art and app.executeMenuCommand("Live PSAdapter_plugin_OcnR"), which opens the 'Ocean Ripple (100%)' Effect Gallery dialog with its last-used values and needs an OK. item.applyEffect('<LiveEffect name="PSAdapter_plugin_OcnR">...</LiveEffect>') stores Ocean Ripple without a dialog, but Ripple Size and Ripple Magnitude sit in a binary descriptor that Dict data cannot carry, so a scripted apply runs with the plug-in's fallback settings, not chosen ones.
use_for: recognising this id in an old action, script or .kys shortcut set and swapping in Effect/Distort/Ocean Ripple
an underwater or water-surface distortion on a photo or type (through Effect/Distort/Ocean Ripple, not this id)
avoid: new artwork and scripts: use Effect/Distort/Ocean Ripple (Live PSAdapter_plugin_OcnR), a live effect that stays re-editable
crisp edges that must stay straight: everything wobbles
